title: Luna Craft
description: Luna Craft is a resource pack that preserves the classic Minecraft feel while enhancing visuals and optimizing textures for smoother, more responsive PvP gameplay.
body:
--- Luna Craft is a resource pack designed to preserve the classic Minecraft experience while enhancing visuals for a smoother and more competitive PvP environment. It keeps the familiar vanilla style but refines key textures to improve clarity, making it easier to track opponents and react quickly during combat. The pack focuses on subtle yet effective improvements, including cleaner weapon textures, more visible armor, and simplified particles that reduce visual clutter. These changes help you stay focused in fast-paced situations without distracting from the original look and feel of the game. Every element is carefully adjusted to maintain balance between aesthetics and performance. Luna Craft is perfect for players who enjoy both casual gameplay and competitive PvP. Whether you're playing on survival servers or practicing duels, the pack provides a clean and responsive experience that gives you a slight visual advantage while still feeling completely natural.
